items.title: Micron (MU) Stock Looks Cheap Even After A Huge Run
items.summary: Micron Technology stock has delivered extremely strong gains over the past three years, yet the current valuation checks give a more cautious, mixed signal rather than a clear green light. Micron Technology has returned about 12x over the last three years, which puts extra focus on whether the current price already reflects a lot of good news. items.title: Micron, SpaceX, Rocket Lab, Fermi, AppLovin, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: The latest consumer price index numbers come out Wednesday.  Micron Technology  rallied late to close up 0.9% at $868.52.  The stock has declined 12% over the past month and well short of its peak of more than $1,200 reached in late June on concerns about the sustainability of sky-high margins in a typically cyclical business.

items.title: Micron Shakes Off Its Slump
items.summary: Micron Technology  stock closed higher for the first time since last Wednesday and Wall Street analysts thinks things will get even better when the market understands just how bad the memory-chip shortage really is.  The memory chip maker’s shares closed up 0.9% at $869.  Arguably very little has changed about Micron’s fundamentals because memory prices keep rising.
